system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: project-logs-dataset
  type: gcp-types/bigquery-v2:datasets
  properties:
    datasetReference:
      datasetId: project_logs_dataset
      projectId: $(env.project)
    location: US
    description: "GCP project logs for long-term analysis."
    access:
    - role: WRITER
      specialGroup: projectWriters
    - role: OWNER
      specialGroup: projectOwners
    - role: READER
      specialGroup: projectReaders

- name: project-logs-to-bq-sink
  type: gcp-types/logging-v2:projects.sinks
  properties:
    sink: project-logs-to-bq-sink
    parent: projects/$(env.project)
    destination: bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/$(env.project)/datasets/$(ref.project-logs-dataset.datasetReference.datasetId)
    filter: ""
    description: "Exports all project logs to a BigQuery dataset."
    uniqueWriterIdentity: true

- name: grant-bq-writer-permission-to-sink
  type: gcp-types/iam.v1.iam
  properties:
    resource: $(ref.project-logs-dataset.selfLink)
    policy:
      bindings:
      - role: roles/bigquery.dataEditor
        members:
        - $(ref.project-logs-to-bq-sink.writerIdentity)
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - project-logs-dataset
    - project-logs-to-bq-sink
